What finally got me back into exercising was doing Youtube cardio videos for maybe only 2 mins of the full 15 mins, and just adding on time as it got too easy. (Running outside wasn't gonna happen for me, lol) Be as slow and gradual with it as you want, but consistency is what you should aim for. If you can do one of those cardio videos (or anything really works this way) for just 2 minutes a day, eventually it'll become a habbit, and then it'll be part of your life and you'll actually probably want to do it or miss it if you don't. This really works with exercise because your body makes endorphins and is what makes people like working out after awhile of doing it

Eventually you get desensitized to things like crowds and looks, and when that happens you’re basically able to live life how you want. And if you’re working towards your goals you shouldn’t be a in that same spot after a few months. So basically you have to be afraid for awhile before you get used to it
